title: Late History Addition on Credit Builder Accounts Goodwill Credits
content:
The goodwill share applied to a Credit Builder late fee grows when the account has few other late fees. "This one" is the late fee the goodwill credit applies to, the account's most recent late fee; the others are the account's remaining late-fee entries, by their dates.

## Clause

When no late fee other than this one was charged on the account in the 12 whole calendar months before today (a line dated today counts, and one dated on the same day of the month 12 months earlier falls outside them), the clean-history addition is added; when exactly one other was, the one-late addition; when two or more were, nothing is added for late history.

| Other late fees in the 12 months | Added to the goodwill share |
|---|---|
| none | clean-history addition: 0.05 (5 percentage points) |
| exactly one | one-late addition: 0.02 (2 percentage points) |
| two or more | nothing |

## Dates on the boundary (hypothetical)

Today 22 February: another late fee dated 22 February of the previous year falls outside; one dated 23 February of the previous year is counted.
